evidence.detail: The combatInfo config interface returns rs/s/a/c from exact keys opponentOverlayStyle, bhOverlayStyle and bossOverlayStyle, with titles 'Opponent overlay style', 'Bounty hunter overlay style' and 'Boss overlay style'.
The enum preserves exactly DEFAULT and COMPACT.
One enum type is intentionally shared by opponent, bounty-hunter and boss overlays, so the role is a common combat-overlay style rather than one feature-specific overlay type.
The combat-info config manager compares these values to COMPACT and writes the resulting runtime flags into shared client settings used by combat overlay presentation.

proposals.note: CombatOverlayStyle is fixed by the exact combatInfo config keys/titles and shared DEFAULT/COMPACT contract across opponent, bounty-hunter and boss overlays. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The combatInfo config interface returns rs/s/a/d from the exact key healthBarStyle with title 'Health bars' and description 'The style of health bar to display'.
The enum preserves exactly OLDSCHOOL and NEWSCHOOL.
The combat-info config manager compares the selected value to NEWSCHOOL and writes the resulting boolean into live client combat-presentation state.

proposals.note: HealthBarStyle follows the exact surviving healthBarStyle config key, health-bar title/description and OLDSCHOOL/NEWSCHOOL values. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The combatInfo config interface returns rs/s/a/e from the exact key hitMarkStyle with title 'Hitsplats'.
The enum preserves exactly OLDSCHOOL_WITH_ICONS, OLDSCHOOL and NEWSCHOOL.
The combat-info config manager distinguishes NEWSCHOOL and OLDSCHOOL_WITH_ICONS and writes the resulting live client hit-mark presentation flags.
The enum is paired with the hitOverlay config section and the adjacent healthBarStyle/multipliedHits settings, fixing it as hit-mark/hitsplat presentation style rather than a generic UI theme.

proposals.note: HitMarkStyle follows the exact hitMarkStyle config key plus OLDSCHOOL_WITH_ICONS/OLDSCHOOL/NEWSCHOOL runtime behavior. Confidence is 0.999.
